Biometric facial-recognition login through the camera via a 'KABUNI LOGIN' voice command, matched against a cloud-held face matrix
Three-tier offline degradation - cloud login over 5G/WiFi, else in-app manual batter override from the parent/child roster, else local storage on the camera for later transfer

Rewards layer and parental activity notifications
hard_problems: India prohibits tracking users via biometric data, which may force geo-locking of the first device release
Many-to-many user/camera relationship forces biometric data into the cloud, making the login path network-dependent by design
Parent/child account hierarchy where an Individual may belong to many Institutions, each with onboarding and off-boarding workflows
GDPR audit trail with aged-data removal, right-to-be-forgotten, and data-request handling, for a 12-16 year-old user base
